clue.text: Quarter fruit in a dignified way

parts.note: SE, south-east, is one of the compass quarters
a date is the fruit of the date palm

explanation.surface: Someone eats a quarter of a piece of fruit with great decorum.
explanation.definitionFit: Something calm, unhurried and composed has the dignified manner the phrase describes.

clue.text: I don't know saucy maiden in court

explanation.surface: A cheeky young woman appears before a judge and pleads ignorance.
explanation.walkthrough: A maiden in cricket is an over with no runs scored, abbreviated M on scorecards.
explanation.definitionFit: The colloquial phrase is a shrugging reply admitting one has no idea.

clue.text: Set of beliefs developed on credit

clue.text: Charles ruled and had a laugh

parts.note: Chuck is a familiar form of the name Charles
led means was in charge of, governed

explanation.surface: King Charles reigned and found it all quite amusing.
explanation.definitionFit: To give a quiet, contented laugh is the past-tense verb the phrase describes.

clue.text: Craftsman is to take in rope

clue.text: Writer settled in advance to make amends

clue.text: The French have opening for ambassador

parts.note: le is the French masculine form of the

explanation.surface: French diplomats get an opening for an envoy.
explanation.definitionFit: A legate is an envoy or emissary, especially one sent by the Pope.

clue.text: Rested awkwardly in place of solitude

clue.text: Composer holds accountant is mysterious

clue.text: Searches for drink with Mike a long time

Mike is M in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.definitionFit: To rummage is to search untidily through things, so the verb forms match.

clue.text: Find fault with food fish

definitions.meaning: a freshwater fish eaten in many countries

clue.text: Record allowed set-up to adopt gold embellishments on uniform

clue.text: Areas for small steps

clue.text: Satisfactory penalty

clue.text: Scold daughter for being clever

D for daughter in genealogy
